verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents running a Scrapy-project spider through `scrapingbee crawl`, so it has some first-party support for one of the named libraries. The rest of the pack describes ScrapingBee's own HTTP API, JS-scenario instruction format and proxy mode, with no mention of Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium. Proxy mode is a generic transport, not a documented integration with those libraries. missing for 10: documented Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium integration (e.g. a remote browser/CDP endpoint or SDK guides), in-depth Scrapy integration docs (middleware/SDK), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy

citations.quote: `scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
